## Design

### 2026-10-22 – October 19: Planning the Beat Board

**10h**

October 19: Planning the Beat Board

Week 3 is here. The theme is Make Some Noise!

This time we decided to make a customized project called the Beat Board. It’s basically a musical device that can play different instruments, including drums and a trumpet. It will have a display and buttons to change tones, modes and switch between instruments. For now we’ve decided to include these two instruments.

Today I started working on the design. I made two to three designs and finally finalized one. This took around two hours because I had to consider the dimensions of the components and figure out how to make the device compact.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-22 at 9.51.46 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/edf7d7969d34c434b30d48055040882458943fe84d418b032b5a09d0b10d777b.jpg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-22 at 9.51.45 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/5255cdae946fa27ade2a8c9ce144fcb3147158c434410239c8c2bdcbd7496b0a.jpg)
I also finalized the components on the day considering which components would be most suitable for the project and how I could reduce the cost make the design more compact and keep it easy to build and maintain.

![Screenshot 2026-10-22 212529](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/0585d40a5e6bbeafb4cb48c82be243601905cbb50090023fc5a571dd79ba8b40.jpg)

![Screenshot 2026-10-22 212104](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/4982251d8591db7905057c9f9b389aaf0718a30826b67801a26112dda8c05094.jpg)
Time spent: 4 hours.

October 20: Creating the Schematic

Today I started working on the Beat Board schematic and its connections.

![Screenshot 2026-10-22 211208](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/0dc14ec6f069b9cea859b42b682d1ea1c2cb54e48100ed414830c57b73df5235.jpg)

![Screenshot 2026-10-22 213015](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/d800d6de876d4459fefbc8d2e5247640dd1e2e431817d3d1123eb47c42f59d24.jpg)

I added all the components, connected them using labels checked the connections and annotated the circuit. I made sure to verify each connection so that everything would be properly connected.

![Screenshot 2026-10-22 211815](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/f492b92f5c3493beef3cfe272e168db68702a2adbbf0d54fac403edf41fa1a12.jpg)

This took around three hours because I had to work on the schematic and check everything carefully.
Time spent: 3 hours.

October 21: Coding and Simulation

Today I started writing the code for the Beat Board. Before moving I wanted to test whether my idea would actually work so I decided to use Wokwi for simulation.

I wrote the code that I planned to use for the project and temporarily removed the display-related part so I could test the functionalities in the simulation.

![Screenshot 2026-10-22 213432](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/7d64f11d14dd87ba7a537d242ef3f25427656e0e91b01361c68e12d2b7bbf29f.jpg)
After writing the code I created the circuit, in Wokwi uploaded the code and tested everything. Fortunately the simulation worked as expected!
![Screenshot 2026-10-22 211143](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/f0aa98993ad73395cdf2c448bb91c5ac1da5b3b97a1513083a0112b9a653b50e.jpg)

![Screenshot 2026-10-22 211450](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/9640fe40a98e7f5ad4fb3519b89a19575e7a4c04c3ddf3115cc9ed206b4242e4.jpg)
It took me around 2.5 hours to prepare the code. Another 30 minutes to set up and test the simulation.

Time spent: 3 hours.

### 2026-10-23 – October 22: PCB Design and Fixing Errors

**9h**

October 22: PCB Design and Fixing Errors

After finishing the schematic, simulation and coding I began working on the PCB design.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-23 at 9.47.20 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/c24882f4d7b06fc8fa184201fffde868ba5eb491efe958c1bfde413ebd6ca5ee.jpg)
On October 22 I made a PCB design. The PCB did not look exactly as I wanted. So I changed the PCB design. Returned to the original idea that I had finalized while planning the project.

![Screenshot 2026-10-23 214951](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/6177d12163ce80249deaf6e95f5ea7dcca9fdb42dd7d670ddbea7094a9d9f2f3.jpg)
Creating the PCB took three hours. After finishing the PCB layout I checked the PCB with the Design Rules Checker and the PCB had 88 errors. Fixing all these PCB errors took two hours.

![Screenshot 2026-10-22 204113](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/b54c4b12261cab95c6903af2781377adc6489d73f9a44e05fd6b769c09bd8cb2.jpg)
Honestly the PCB process was quite hectic because of component wiring. This time I used 90‑degree wiring and the wiring was much easier and more convenient.

![Screenshot 2026-10-22 214232](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/e97c692b8e0750e1a72e61f6d493a0d6193433d522d8c4c80a78bad756da7e20.jpg)
Time spent: 5 hours.

October 23: Adding Designs and the Trumpet Mode

Today I began by adding graffiti‑style designs to the PCBs silkscreen on both the front and back. I added text and designs including guitar and keyboard logos to make the PCB look cooler. This process took one hour.

![Screenshot 2026-10-23 215249](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/2d675995e2ce313f68b15c5b8be8c6a26e22e8edc8ee98ba31c45891f4167f8d.jpg)
After that I began working on the code for the trumpet mode. As I mentioned earlier I wanted to include two instruments on the Beat Board: drums and trumpet.

![Screenshot 2026-10-23 220119](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/d53d1563d397d0014ad09114ec8175032b5c8a6970b7ecdcc331257de77c7962.jpg)
So I wrote the code needed for the trumpet and edited my existing drum code to include both instruments.

![Screenshot 2026-10-23 213807](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/76dd430223c6331716af68bcb356b4277018dc0b8974ee2f34c3aec6b053831e.jpg)
Once the coding was finished I tested everything in the simulation. I checked whether I could switch between both instruments and whether everything was working as expected.

![Screenshot 2026-10-23 213726](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/111fec65147e6192ca841579965f2f91c47b776e6261b7654989fafa07a9c9fc.jpg)
The coding took about 2.5 hours and the simulation and testing took another 30 minutes.

That is all! I have finally finished the project. It was quite a journey, from planning the design and creating the schematic to designing the PCB fixing errors adding artwork and coding both instruments.
Time spent: 4 hours
